meta.title: Faster @ references
meta.description: Preloads the workspace file and DSH session indexes so the @ menu filters and ranks in the browser instead of asking the Host on every keystroke, and lets you shape what @ searches in Settings → @ search scope: skip archived sessions, skip sessions idle for N days, skip subagents outside this conversation, and show file paths flat or as a tree. Files, folders and sessions keep their native mention text. The index is a snapshot: new files can take up to 30 seconds to appear, the session list refreshes every 5 minutes, and the 10,000-entry cap truncates very large workspaces.
